title: neottia caurina
intro: Neottia caurina, commonly known as the California pipevine, is a perennial orchid native to the western coast of North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Neottia caurina are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, making it a popular remedy among herbalists. Bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
